spots.name: Eagle Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,555 m (8,383 ft).

spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
